candidate_windows.window_text:
VT3 is implemented using the Hugging Face library (Wolf et al., 2020). The backbone of VT3 is the pre-trained BARTbase model, and the vision backbone is a frozen Swinlarge (Liu et al., 2022) model pre-trained on ImageNet-21K at a resolution of $384 \times 384$ . Extracted visual embeddings for an image consist of 144 features having a dimension length of 1536. In total, VT3 has 339M parameters (including 197M belonging to Swin). We optimize training using the AdamW optimizer (Kingma and Ba, 2015) with a learning rate of 2e-5, a warmup for 2000 steps from 1e-7, and a batch size of 200 with a gradient accumulation value of 2. The model is trained for about 120K steps on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, which takes $\sim 48$ hours to complete the training process. For details, refer code4.
